measurement.sampling: The full-suite initial baseline has one invocation, with CPU and GPU in the same process: two warmups, 101 warm-frame samples and one iteration per sample; playback and seek each use 90 frames. Warm-frame P95 is eligible, sequences and five batch-mean microbenchmarks are not. Separately, R3-8 has six fresh alternating AB/BA pairs for Empty/Shapes/Blur/Shadow/Bloom at 640x360, both backends, with CPU stages enabled and sequences/micro/video/cold disabled. A separate six-pair small-kernel follow-up compares the new candidate against the same original pre-R3-8 control; the two cohorts are not pooled. These focused pairs provide per-case uncertainty estimates, not a full-suite speedup claim.
measurement.scope: Apple M3 (Metal GPU), macOS, aarch64, release, 640x360 Final, bundled Noto Sans, 72 particles, 1 GiB/20-billion-work benchmark policy. All 29 cases, both backends, playback/seek and five microbenchmarks were measured; cold sessions, stages and video export were disabled. GPU and FFmpeg were enabled in the frozen build, but films was not. Runtime/workload sources match the captured revision; post-build changes are reporting/archival-only edits to benches/report.cjs and benches/baseline.cjs, plus the scheduling-only films gate in crates/motion-bench/Cargo.toml. Breadth has incomplete artifacts and is deferred with Criterion; neither is registered. This is not Studio FPS, process RSS, full-film acceptance, cross-device evidence or improvement over deleted history. Verification details: target/performance/non-films-1793845901725/source-verification.json.

steps.change: CPU uniform box blur uses fixed six-part compensated f64 rolling sums instead of per-tap sampling; fractional small-sigma path retained. Candidate executable 4d96bd533c2ea163. steps.verification: Six alternating AB/BA pairs, 12 independent process invocations, all 50 records each: exact reference pixels/checksums, frozen executable hashes, matched configuration/settings/environment/adapter and nonoverlapping intervals validated by benches/pair.cjs and benches/report.cjs. steps.notes: Performance acceptance is incomplete: CPU Bloom warm-frame P50 83.408 -> 46.990 ms, paired improvement 42.88% [41.05,45.79]; Blur 13.228 -> 27.372 ms, paired -106.70% [-116.20,-100.56]; Shadow 17.301 -> 28.136 ms, paired -64.78% [-65.86,-58.27]. Stage-linear confirms the same directions. CPU Empty/Shapes and GPU warm-frame P50 are uncertain. GPU Empty P95 has a small borderline regression: -1.12% [-1.56,-0.01], retained rather than dismissed. All other positive, negative and uncertain observations remain in detailed tables; no cross-case aggregate, film/Studio FPS, RSS or general speedup claim. Small uniform kernels need separate optimization/acceptance. Disk-full and incomplete attempts remain preserved, not pooled with completed pairs.

steps.label: 01 R3-8 small-kernel direct taps

Only cpu/filter.rs differs from that previous candidate.
